purpose: Provider ground truth for the Liga MX build (feat-liga-mx), archived BEFORE any push per repo standard.

split_season_structure.season_types_observed: Torneo Apertura (hasStandings=true) followed by Apertura play-in phases (7th-vs-8th, 9th-vs-10th, 8th-seed game) and Liguilla rounds (quarterfinals, semifinals, ...), each hasStandings=false — see ligamx_espn_standings_2026-07-29.json seasons[0].types
split_season_structure.standings_children: one child PER TOURNAMENT, named with the tournament ('2026 Torneo Apertura', 18 entries, 2 matchdays played at probe time); standings.name='overall', seasonDisplayName='2026-27 Liga BBVA MX'
split_season_structure.scoreboard_events_carry: season {year, type, slug:'torneo-apertura'} per event; team-schedule events carry seasonType {id, name, abbreviation}

espn.team_schedule_endpoint: mex.1/teams/{id}/schedule serves the CURRENT tournament: bare = played (2 events for GDL), fixture=true = upcoming (15 events) — same split as usa.1/eng.1, so src/live/ingest.py works unchanged
espn.summary_endpoint: mex.1/summary?event= carries EVERY STAT_ORDER boxscore key plus passing/crossing/tackling extras, lastFiveGames, seasonseries (h2h), keyEvents, rosters (21 players/side: starter flag, formationPlace, jersey, subbedIn/Out, per-player stats incl. goals/assists/shots/cards/saves), and per-category leaders
espn.player_stats: roster per-player stat names: appearances, foulsCommitted, foulsSuffered, goalAssists, goalsConceded, offsides, ownGoals, redCards, saves, shotsFaced, shotsOnTarget, subIns, totalGoals, totalShots — NO xG
espn.xg: per-player expectedGoals / expectedGoalsConceded appear ONLY on the single leader per category in the leaders block; NO team-level match xG anywhere in the summary
espn.non_ascii: club displayNames carry Spanish accents (América, Atlético de San Luis, León, Querétaro) and so do player names (Efraín Álvarez) — end-to-end non-ASCII handling required
espn.relegation_note: Mazatlán is NOT in the 2026-27 mex.1 club list; Atlante (espn id 226) replaced it

official_liga_mx_api.consequence: ESPN mex.1 is the club+player stats source; goals-only model; no scraping

kalshi.grammar: IDENTICAL to KXMLSGAME: {SERIES}-{YYMONDD}{HOMECODE}{AWAYCODE} event tickers (dates US-Eastern; verified 26JUL31PUECDG = ESPN 2026-08-01T01:00Z Guadalajara at Puebla), ' vs ' titles home-first, market tails = team code / TIE

family_series_verified_live.KXLIGAMXTOTAL: 6 open markets on PUECDG; tail n = over (n-1).5 (tail 2 titled 'Over 1.5 goals scored')
family_series_verified_live.KXLIGAMXSPREAD: tail {CODE}{n} = wins by more than (n-0.5) ('PUE2' titled 'Puebla wins by more than 1.5 goals')
family_series_verified_live.KXLIGAMXMOV: series EXISTS but 0 open events at probe time
family_series_verified_live.KXLIGAMXCUP: does NOT exist (404) — no futures series, none invented

kalshi.title_sides_observed_25_26_and_open: 36 distinct across 221 events — America, CF America, Atlante, Atlas, Atlas FC, Atletico San Luis, San Luis, CD Guadalajara, Guadalajara, CF Cruz Azul, Cruz Azul, CF Monterrey, Monterrey, CF Pachuca, Pachuca, Club Leon, Leon, Club Necaxa, Necaxa, Club Puebla, Puebla, Club Santos Laguna, Santos Laguna, Club Tijuana de Caliente, Tijuana de Caliente, Deportivo Toluca FC, Toluca, FC Juarez, Juarez, Mazatlan, Mazatlan FC, Pumas UNAM, Queretaro, Queretaro FC, Tigres, Tigres UANL (Kalshi titles are ASCII — accents stripped)
kalshi.bridge_curation: every side maps to a current ESPN club except Mazatlan/Mazatlan FC (relegated — deliberately absent from bridges)

competition_identity_decision.rationale: Matches ESPN's season year 2026 (= the 2026-27 cycle: Apertura 2026 + its Liguilla + Clausura 2027 + its Liguilla). The shared ingest machinery (per-team schedules + dated scoreboards) serves the whole mex.1 season with no tournament filter hook, so a per-tournament slug would silently absorb the other tournament's fixtures the day Clausura schedules appear; scoping the competition to the full ESPN season is the honest boundary that needs no third refactor of shared code. The TOURNAMENT is recorded everywhere it matters: per-event 'tournament' field on scoreboard/schedule cards, per-table tournament label on standings (derived from ESPN's own child name), and the current tournament on /api/ligamx/status — all derived from provider data, never hardcoded.
competition_identity_decision.rejected_alternative: liga-mx-apertura-2026 (per-tournament slug) — cleaner tournament identity but requires tournament filtering inside shared ingest (a third parallel refactor of src/live/ingest.py, against the build's isolation constraint) and a new competition row + reseed every six months.
